exposed_assumptions.assumption: the cysteine-catalysed pentose trunk (r_pent_dpo / r_pent_tdp, one shared Ea of 64 kJ/mol) destroys cysteine and pentose in seconds where Cao 2017 and Zhang 2025b measure hours, so on a converged trajectory the 100-120 C cysteine + pentose pots over-make MFT (fit rows up to +2.5 sigma; the old oscillating pH hid it). B59 replaces the trunk with de Roos's Cys-Amadori network
exposed_assumptions.wave: B60 (the pH trajectory converged: log-and-linear nodes, relaxed fixed point, closed flux budget)

exposed_assumptions.assumption: the furfural branch's temperature and pH dependence (TDP -> furfural -> + H2S -> FFT) is not measured: the model's FFT/MFT is 6-60x the measured ratio and the excess grows as the temperature falls, so FFT no longer rises from 100 C / 4 h to 120 C / 1 h, and furfural no longer falls monotonically from pH 4 to 6 (docs/guides/SULFUR_FLUX_MAP.md sec. 5)

headline_sentences: **Absolute concentrations are unreliable.** On the union panel the kinetic core lands 21/66 rows within 3x (median fold error 7.87x, worst 2.87e+04x); out of sample -- every row a core fit read removed -- 14/56 (median 11.8x). Nothing in this repository licenses a ppb number as a specification. The core's 90% Monte-Carlo interval covers 36/65 evaluable literature rows (1 not evaluable: the no lane carries no sampled uncertainty), 29/55 out of sample.

**Directional and ranking claims are the product, and on the kinetic core they score 20/33 on strictly independent literature claims** (42 independent claims not evaluable: refused arms, prose-only claims, observables the core does not represent) -- 14/22 once pH and water activity are set aside, and 6/11 on pH and water activity themselves, 0 of the misses being identical predictions across an axis the lane carries no term for. A coin scores ~0.5 on binary orderings; read the per-axis rows below, not the aggregate.

**The sulfur branch has 8 absolute literature anchors, and the model lands 5 of its 7 scored anchor rows within 3x (0 of the 0 that no core fit read; the rest are fed-intermediate rows the sulfur fit read, which are not evidence).** They are the primary-source-verified stable-isotope-dilution rows in hofmann1998_c2c3_recombination_145C_20min_pH3, hofmann1998_c2c3_recombination_145C_20min_pH5, hofmann1998_c2c3_recombination_145C_20min_pH7, hofmann1998_fructose_cysteine_145C_20min_pH5, hofmann1998_furan2aldehyde_h2s_145C_20min_pH5, hofmann1998_glucose_cysteine_145C_20min_pH5, hofmann1998_norfuraneol_cysteine_145C_20min_pH5, hofmann1998_ribose_cysteine_145C_20min_pH5. A further 1 primary-source-verified sulfur row(s) are on the panel and are NOT counted here, because a constant was selected by looking at them (hofmann1998_norfuraneol_h2s_145C_20min_pH5): agreement on a fitted row is not evidence about the model. The previously shipped claim of ZERO anchors was corrected on 2026-08-28 when the full text behind them was obtained; the retired benchmark (cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998, two values derived inside the repository, never measured) was deleted on 2026-10-27. Absolute agreement is poor and the DIRECTION is a separate question.

sulfur_anchor.fit_target_note: Rows listed under `..._that_are_fit_targets` carry a `fit_target_declaration` block, i.e. a constant was selected by looking at them. They are primary-source verified and they are NOT counted as anchors: agreement on a fitted row carries no information about the model. They are listed rather than deleted because excluding a fitted row removes its MISSES as well as its hits, and at the time of writing the one row here is a miss.
